title: MAC Flooding Attack
description: Understand CAM table overflow and mitigate it with port security.
scenario: Understand CAM table overflow and mitigate it with port security.

concepts.title: How MAC Flooding Works
concepts.body: The attacker blasts thousands of fake source MAC addresses. The CAM table fills up, and the switch falls back to flooding all frames out every port in the VLAN.
concepts.code:
Attacker → fake MAC #1..N
CAM table full → switch floods unknown unicast

concepts.title: Why It Is Dangerous
concepts.body: While flooded, the attacker receives traffic meant for other hosts — a sniffing position inside the same VLAN.
concepts.code:
Normal:  unicast → learned port only
Flooded: unicast → ALL ports in VLAN

concepts.title: Mitigation
concepts.body: Port security caps learned MACs per port. With maximum 1 + sticky, the first legitimate MAC is pinned and extras trigger the configured violation mode.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security maximum 1
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security mac-address sticky
